objective: Make the Pi extension tests pass on the windows-latest CI job for PR #88 (release/0.3.0/fix/pi-windows-launch) without weakening them, and fix any real Windows defect they expose in the Bun lookup or launch.
scope: CI log of the failing windows job at cc85aa7 (same tree): /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/win-88.log; 103 of 2426 tests fail, all in packages/integrations/pi/tests (extension.test.ts, session-context.test.ts, contract.test.ts and the Bun lookup tests). Unique failing names: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/win-88-fails.txt.

Representative failure: "holyagent config \work\project\.holyagent failed: Bun was not found on PATH or in BUN_INSTALL/bin or ~/.bun/bin (neither BUN_INSTALL nor the home folder is set)". The tests stub Bun as /stub/bin/bun with BUN_SEARCH; on real win32 the lookup skips driveless PATH entries and may look for bun.exe, so the stub is never found and every collection fails closed (status calls empty, holyagent-notice instead of holyagent-context). The finding Bun unit tests and a Windows package root tests fail too, and several tests hit the 5 s timeout.
Relevant source: packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts (Bun lookup, exec, cmd.exe launch), packages/integrations/pi/src/bun-flags.ts.
